Let
\[
R(k)=\frac{f(k+1)}{f(k)}=\frac{(k+1)^2/k^2}{1.001}.
\]
The maximum occurs when \(R(k)\) drops below \(1\). We need
\[
R(k)>1 \iff \left(1+\frac1k\right)^2>1.001.
\]
Thus
\[
1+\frac1k>\sqrt{1.001}\approx 1.000499875,
\]
so
\[
k<\frac{1}{\sqrt{1.001}-1}\approx 2000.5.
\]
Hence \(R(k)>1\) for \(k\le 2000\), and \(R(k)<1\) for \(k\ge 2001\). Therefore \(f(k)\) increases through \(k=2001\) and then decreases.

\[
\boxed{2001}
\]
